findings.title: Suspicious Export Name

findings.recommendation: Remove debug/test functions before deploying to mainnet. Ensure no development backdoors are left in production contracts.

findings.title: Soroban Host Function Summary

findings.title: Cryptographic Host Functions Used
findings.description: Contract uses 1 cryptographic host function(s): c._. Verify cryptographic operations are used correctly.
findings.recommendation: Ensure hash functions are used for integrity, not as a substitute for authorization. Verify signature verification uses the correct key.

findings.title: Sensitive Function Without Authorization
findings.description: Exported function 'admin_emergency_withdraw' has a privilege-sensitive name but no authorization check was detected in its call chain.
findings.recommendation: Verify that this function enforces caller authorization before executing.

findings.title: Cross-Contract Call Detected
findings.description: Function 'refund' invokes an external contract. Verify the callee is trusted and call arguments are validated.
findings.recommendation: Ensure cross-contract call targets are trusted. Handle failure cases from try_call appropriately.
